description: This file defines a PHP class 'ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams' which extends 'FilterParams' and is used to encapsulate search filter parameters for claim requests within a Human Resource Management System. It includes constants, properties, and getter/setter methods to handle filtering criteria such as employee inclusion, reference ID, employee numbers, event ID, status, and date ranges.

classes.name: ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object used for filtering claim request searches, managing various filter criteria and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with default sort field and order.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the current includeEmployees filter value.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date filter, adjusting time to end of the day if necessary.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee numbers filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers filter.
